"""Text helpers."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(text, max_length=50):
    """Turn a title into a URL slug (see the tests for the rules)."""
    ascii_text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", ascii_text.lower()).strip("-")
    if len(slug) > max_length:
        cut = slug.rfind("-", 0, max_length + 1)
        slug = slug[:cut] if cut > 0 else slug[:max_length]
        slug = slug.strip("-")
    return slug or "n-a"

args.command: python3 -c 'from textutil import slugify; print(slugify("Crème Brûlée"), slugify("alpha beta gamma", 12))'
